title: Detailed usage
text: path already exists, get_group() decides . download folder containing .version, written end successful get_group(). group_id output_format given, read .id .format.
code: # download again even though nothing changed get_group(path = "nff", force = TRUE)  # switch the folder to CSL JSON get_group(path = "nff", output_format = "csljson") #> Format changes from bibtex to csljson - downloading again. #> ...  # never touch an existing download get_group(path = "nff", update = FALSE) #> Error in get_group(path = "nff", update = FALSE) : #>   `path` nff contains a download. Delete it or use `update = TRUE`.  # a folder that is not a download is protected get_group(4937409, path = "my_documents") #> Error in get_group(4937409, path = "my_documents") : #>   `path` my_documents exists and is not a previous download (no `.version`). Use `overwrite = TRUE` to delete it.  # the folder belongs to another group get_group(1, path = "nff") #> Error in group_outdated(path, group_id = group_id, api_key = api_key) : #>   `nff` contains group 4937409 but group 1 was requested.

title: Detailed usage
text: group_outdated() compares folder server. returns logical named group id: TRUE server newer version. raises error server version older downloaded one, happen real group. .version set 999999999 hand: quick overview several downloads:
code: group_outdated("nff") #> 4937409 #>   FALSE group_outdated("nff") #> Error in group_outdated("nff") : #>   Server version (2053) of group 4937409 is older than the downloaded version (999999999). dirs <- list.dirs("ipbes_groups", recursive = FALSE) unlist(lapply(dirs, group_outdated))

title: Detailed usage
text: get_groups_from_user() downloads every group Zotero user sub-folders named <group name>_<group id>, runs get_group() , update rules apply per group. Public groups work without API key; private groups need key read access, created zotero.org/settings/security. Note api_key defaults environment variable ZOTERO_API_IPBES. user stored .user_id .user_name path, later update needs folder: Without output_format, existing groups keep format .format new groups use "rdf_zotero". group fails (example private group without key) prints error next group continues.
code: get_groups_from_user(   zotero_user_name = "ipbes",   path = "ipbes_groups",   output_format = "bibtex",   api_key = Sys.getenv("ZOTERO_API_KEY") ) get_groups_from_user(path = "ipbes_groups", api_key = Sys.getenv("ZOTERO_API_KEY"))

title: Get Zotero Group Data — get_group
text: group_id ID Zotero group. NULL, read file .id path (written previous download), existing download can updated giving path. path path save retrieved data. output_format format output files. Supported : bibtex: BibTeX format biblatex: BibLaTeX format bookmarks: Firefox bookmarks HTML format coins: COinS format csljson: Citation Style Language (CSL) JSON format csv: Comma-separated values format mods: MODS format refer: Refer/BibIX format rdf_bibliontology: RDF/Bibliographic Ontology format rdf_dc: RDF/Dublin Core format rdf_zotero: RDF/Zotero format ris: RIS format tei: TEI format wikipedia: Wikipedia citation templates format NULL: Zotero's JSON (complete, slowest) See Zotero documentation details formats. given, read .format path (written previous download), otherwise NULL. api_key API key Zotero. needed private groups. update TRUE, existing previous download path updated (see Details). FALSE, existing download error. Default: TRUE. force TRUE, download even downloaded version equals server version. FALSE, download server version larger. Default: FALSE. overwrite TRUE, existing non-empty path previous download deleted replaced. FALSE, error. Default: FALSE.

title: Get all Groups from a User — get_groups_from_user
text: zotero_user_name Name user download groups . Default: "ipbes". given path contains .user_id file (written previous run), user id read , existing download can updated giving path. zotero_user_id Zotero user id download groups . Default: read path/.user_id present, otherwise obtained function id_from_name. Must match path/.user_id exist. scripts, give id explicitly: id_from_name() parses profile page, may change. path Folder save groups . output_format output_format files. See get_group. given, existing group downloads keep format stored .format file; new groups use default "rdf_zotero". api_key Zotero API key, needed private groups. Default: environment variable ZOTERO_API_IPBES. update FALSE, existing path error. Otherwise passed get_group: existing group downloads updated. Default: TRUE. force Passed get_group: download even group outdated. Default: FALSE. overwrite Passed get_group: replace existing group folders previous downloads. Default: FALSE.
